_comment_triggers: Every trigger type — fires once each (max_found: 1). Enter any of these conditions to unlock the research.

triggers._comment: TRIGGER: kill_entity with NBT filter — fires when player kills a named zombie

_comment_tasks: Every task type — one per stage. Complete them in order (stage 0 → 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5).

2._comment: TASK: craft / craft_item — craft 1 stick (auto-completes on craft, no slot needed). station controls the icon shown.

3._comment: TASK: ritual_completion / use_ritual — complete shadow patronage ritual once

4._comment: TASK: item with count > 1 — collect 5 oak logs to test count field
commands: tellraw @s {"text":"[Debug] Stage 4 complete: item count task","color":"green"}

5._comment: TASK: kill_entity alias — same as kill, tests alternate type string
5.command: tellraw @s {"text":"[Debug] Stage 5 complete: kill_entity alias task","color":"gold"}

_comment_rewards: rewards run when all tasks are completed (onLearned). Supported types: sign, item, command, commands.

rewards._comment: REWARD: grant a sign by full resource location
REWARD: run a command ({player} is replaced with the player's name)
rewards.command: tellraw {player} {"text":"[Debug] All tasks complete — rewards granted!","color":"gold"}
